title: Custom Sports Team Apparel | VAM Deco
description: Custom kits, t-shirts and hoodies for teams and tournaments in Ticino. Quality DTF printing and embroidery. Request a free quote from VAM Deco.
estratto: Custom kits, t-shirts, hoodies and vests for teams and tournaments, with quality DTF printing and embroidery in Ticino.

paragrafi: The kit is the first sign of a team's identity. At VAM Deco we personalise t-shirts, football kits, hoodies, jackets and high-visibility vests for sports clubs, tournaments and events. We use DTF printing and embroidery, techniques built to withstand intensive use and frequent washing.

sezioni.heading: What we can personalise
paragrafi: We customise every garment with a logo, name and number, in a wide range of colours and sizes:
lista: T-shirts and polos for training sessions, events and tournaments.
Complete kits for football, five-a-side and basketball (shirt, shorts, socks).
Hoodies and jackets for outdoor training and winter events.
High-visibility vests for staff, referees and organisers.

sezioni.heading: DTF printing or embroidery: which to choose
paragrafi: DTF (Direct to Film) printing is the best choice for numbers, names, colourful logos and detailed graphics. It delivers vivid colours, has no setup costs when the design changes from garment to garment, and works well even on technical fabrics.
Embroidery, on the other hand, gives an elegant, three-dimensional effect. It's ideal on polos, hoodies and jackets when you want a more classic look that lasts over time.

sezioni.heading: How much it costs and how to order
paragrafi: The price depends on the garment, the quantity and the technique you choose. Thanks to DTF printing there's no high minimum order, so we can personalise small groups and amateur teams too.

You send us your logo, colours and the list of names and numbers. We prepare the design proof and, once it's approved, we start production. We agree on the delivery date together right from the quote stage.

sezioni.heading: Why choose VAM Deco
paragrafi: Durable, breathable fabrics, crisp and long-lasting personalisation, experience with teams across different disciplines, and expert advice to guide you in choosing the garment, technique and design. We help you build a recognisable identity for your team.
Get in touch for a free consultation and request your quote.

faq.domanda: How much do custom kits for a team cost?
faq.risposta: It depends on the type of garment, the quantity and the technique (DTF printing or embroidery). The more pieces you order, the lower the unit price. Get in touch with your requirements and we'll prepare a free, no-obligation quote for you.

faq.domanda: Is DTF printing or embroidery better for names and numbers?
faq.risposta: For numbers, names and colourful logos, DTF printing is the ideal solution: it's durable and cost-effective when the design changes from garment to garment. Embroidery is perfect when you want an elegant, classic effect on polos and hoodies.

faq.domanda: Is there a minimum order to personalise apparel?
faq.risposta: With DTF printing there's no high minimum order, so we can personalise small groups or just a few shirts too. For large quantities we apply dedicated pricing.

faq.domanda: How long does it take to get the kits?
faq.risposta: Timing depends on the quantity and the garments you choose. Once you approve the design proof we start production and agree on the delivery date together right at the quote stage.

faq.domanda: Can I put a logo, name and number on every shirt?
faq.risposta: Yes. We personalise every garment with the team or sponsor logo, plus each player's name and number, in the colours and sizes you prefer.
